text.EN: Evening. Need something before we turn in?
text.TL: Gabi. Kailangan mo ng isang bagay bago tayo lumiko?

text.EN: Good, it's only you. You startled me.
text.TL: Buti, ikaw lang. Ginulat mo ako.

text.EN: Not much daylight left. Talk to me.
text.TL: Wala na masyadong liwanag ng araw. kausapin mo ako.

text.EN: Hey. Keeping watch, or just passing by?
We should keep this quiet, but I'm listening.
text.TL: Dapat tahimik lang tayo rito, pero nakikinig ako.
